scope: Bounded review of ops-d73-exact-nodes/README.md against the immutable launcher, request-test, test-run, suites.conf, receipts, and prior protected source reviews.

findings.summary: Both suite rows omit the Python pytest module invocation.
findings.evidence: README.md:28-29 pass '-o addopts=' as the first argument after 'run --'. The reviewed launcher line 160 executes '<manifest python> -P \"$@\"' for run mode. The private probe 'python3 -P -o addopts= ...' exits 2 with 'Unknown option: -o'.
findings.required_fix: The installed row body must begin '-m pytest -q -o addopts= -m integration -p no:cacheprovider --timeout=45 ...'; retain the exact --files selectors as runner-appended arguments.

findings.summary: Evidence identity is static per suite row, not bound to request-test's generated test ID.
findings.evidence: README.md:28-29 hard-code P4_D73_REQUEST_ID and the XML path. request-test line 13 generates a unique central ID, while test-run lines 44-45/117-119 pass only D66_OUTPUT_DIR to the command and do not export the central ID or rewrite the row. Repeated requests therefore reuse the same launcher evidence names and XML path.
findings.required_fix: Bind P4_D73_EVIDENCE and P4_D73_REQUEST_ID to the per-run output/ID supplied by the supported runner (or add an explicitly reviewed runner adapter); do not claim per-ID retention from fixed row literals.

findings.summary: Exact Agent origins do not contain the reviewed launcher source.
findings.evidence: Both exact Agent commits contain tools/p4-d73-pinned-launch.sh with SHA-256 cec561761cb90adbe94dbcc1b1f6b62afb107f1a90e079c6ce2b823405a072d1, while reviewed source 375c773... is 9f668e398b1ea4cce48a6c610102723e0a3dab27a764be4191015aa7fc4110cd. The exact-origin launcher exports PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 in both child shells; the reviewed source changes those lines to unset PYTHONNOUSERSITE.
findings.required_fix: Obtain an orchestrator-approved new receipt-backed source/manifest revision that carries the exact selected/fork test origins plus the reviewed launcher, or explicitly revise the tuple. No supported checkout currently satisfies both frozen commits and the reviewed launcher; do not copy or silently substitute the launcher.

findings.summary: The five declared admission/evidence needs remain missing.
missing: both candidate suite rows installed in central suites.conf
findings.evidence: The Runtime ab1e receipt exists and is clean; no matching Agent checkout receipts or candidate suite rows were found, and no D73 body was run.
